title: pharn-ci policy document, version 1
description: An organization's policy for pharn-ci: what safe to merge means for a repository. Served by pharn.dev (the policy field of the GET /policy response) or read from a JSON file in the repository. Untrusted input: every object is closed, every list and string is bounded. Every key except version is optional, and this schema implies no default. Tighten rules describe how item 20 merges layers; nothing in this schema merges.

version.description: Policy document version; must be 1. Not merged: every layer carries the same version.

threshold.description: Minimum diff coverage percentage, 0-100; feeds the diff coverage gate. Tighten: numbers, max wins.

exclude.description: GLOB patterns of files left out of diff coverage; feeds the diff coverage gate. Tighten: POLICY-SPEC gives no rule for this key; item 20 decides.

root.description: ROOT directory that relative coverage paths start from, or null for none; feeds the diff coverage gate. Tighten: POLICY-SPEC gives no rule for this key; item 20 decides.

require.description: Whether at least one agent setup file is required; feeds P01. Tighten: booleans, true wins.

expect.description: Agent tools whose setup files must be present (names from AGENT_TOOLS); feeds P01. Tighten: required lists, union.

consistency.description: Severity of contradictory agent setup files; feeds P07. Tighten: severities, block > warn > info > off.

forbidden_permissions.description: PERM rules an agent settings file must not allow; feeds P02. Tighten: forbidden_* lists, union.

required_permissions_deny.description: PERM rules that must appear in permissions.deny; feeds P03. Tighten: required_* lists, union.

allowed_mcp_servers.description: MCP server NAMEs allowed; an empty list means any server; feeds P04. Tighten: allowed_* lists, intersection (an empty allowlist means any, the loosest; a non-empty one restricts).

forbidden_mcp_servers.description: MCP server names or command globs (NAME_OR_GLOB) that must not be configured; feeds P05. Tighten: forbidden_* lists, union.

required_hooks.description: Hooks (an event and an optional matcher) that must exist in the agent settings; feeds P06. Tighten: required_* lists, union.

forbidden_files.description: GLOB patterns of files that must not be tracked; feeds P08. Tighten: forbidden_* lists, union.

mode.description: How test-integrity findings affect the verdict; feeds the TI signals. Tighten: mode, block > warn > off.

signals.description: Per-signal severity overrides, keyed by signal id TI01-TI16; any other key (TI17 included) is an error; feeds the TI signals. Tighten: per-signal severities, block > warn > info > off.

TI01.description: Severity of signal TI01. Tighten: block > warn > info > off.

accept_label.description: LABEL that signs off test-integrity blocks on a pull request; feeds the TI sign-off. Never read from .pharn/ci.yml. Tighten: POLICY-SPEC gives no rule for this key; item 20 decides.

quarantine.description: Whether known flaky tests are quarantined; feeds flaky test handling. Tighten: booleans, true wins.

policy.description: Policy mode settings and rule severities (P01-P14).

required.description: Whether an unavailable policy blocks the check; feeds P10. Tighten: booleans, true wins.

rules.description: Per-rule severity overrides, keyed by rule id P01-P14; any other key is an error. Tighten: per-rule severities, block > warn > info > off.

P01.description: Severity of rule P01. Tighten: block > warn > info > off.

agents.description: Agent pull request detection and rules (P11, P12, P14).

labels.description: Pull request LABELs that mark an agent pull request; feeds agent PR detection for P11, P12 and P14. Tighten: union.

extra_logins.description: Extra GitHub LOGINs whose pull requests are agent pull requests; feeds agent PR detection for P11, P12 and P14. Tighten: union.

protected_paths.description: GLOB patterns an agent pull request must not touch; feeds P11. Tighten: union.

protected_paths_mode.description: What touching a protected path does; feeds P11. Tighten: mode, block > warn.

require_human_approval.description: Whether an agent pull request needs a human approval; feeds P12. Tighten: true wins.

max_files.description: Most files an agent pull request may change, an integer 1-100000; feeds P14. Tighten: a cap, so the smaller limit wins (POLICY-SPEC's numbers rule, max wins, would loosen it); item 20 decides.

max_changed_lines.description: Most changed lines an agent pull request may have, an integer 1-10000000; feeds P14. Tighten: a cap, so the smaller limit wins (POLICY-SPEC's numbers rule, max wins, would loosen it); item 20 decides.

registries.description: Package ecosystems whose new dependencies are checked; each maps to a fixed host list in the Action, so a policy never names a host. Tighten: dependencies.registries, intersection.

min_age_days.description: Minimum age in days of a newly added dependency version, an integer 0-3650. Tighten: dependencies.min_*, max wins.

min_weekly_downloads.description: Minimum weekly downloads of a newly added dependency, an integer 0-1000000000. Tighten: dependencies.min_*, max wins.

severity.description: SEV: block, warn, info or off.

glob.description: GLOB: a repo-relative glob pattern (*, ** and ?), 1-512 characters: not starting with ./, / or !; not ending with /; no //; no .. segment; none of the characters \ { } [ ]; no control character; no leading or trailing white space.

root.description: ROOT: a normalized repo-relative directory, 1-512 characters; . is the repository root: no \; not absolute (no leading /, no X: drive); no .. segment; not starting with - or ./; not ending with /; no //; no control character; no leading or trailing white space.

permission.description: PERM: a permission rule such as Tool or Tool(pattern), 1-512 characters, no control character.

name.description: NAME: a plain name, 1-128 characters, no control character, no leading or trailing white space.

nameOrGlob.description: NAME_OR_GLOB: a plain name or command glob, 1-512 characters, no control character, no leading or trailing white space.

label.description: LABEL: a pull request label, 1-50 characters, no control character, no leading or trailing white space.

login.description: LOGIN: a GitHub login (a letter or digit, then up to 38 letters, digits or -), optionally followed by [bot]; at most 44 characters.

requiredHook.description: A hook that must exist: an event and an optional matcher.

event.description: Hook event name, letters only, 1-64 characters (for example PreToolUse); feeds P06. Tighten: part of required_hooks, union.

matcher.description: Tool matcher the hook must cover, 1-512 characters, no control character, no leading or trailing white space; omitted means any tool; feeds P06. Tighten: part of required_hooks, union.
